title: Senate staff meet Mellon, Puthoff, Davis, the Skinwalker team and the Tic Tac pilots
place_text: Capitol Hill, Washington, D.C.; Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: I saw his name associated with this and it was easy to uh reconnect with with Chris and we met Lou and we met Dr. Put off and Dr. Davis and uh um uh we met the f other folks who had been working on the um on the ranch in uh in in in Utah and we met Brandon Fugal,

plain: In 2017 and 2018, a US Senate staff member named Kurt McConnell says, he and his colleagues met in Washington with a group of people tied to UFO research. He names Chris Mellon, Luis Elizondo, the physicists Harold Puthoff and Eric W. Davis, the people who had worked on Skinwalker Ranch (a property in Utah studied for strange events), Brandon Fugal, and the Navy pilots David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, who reported the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. McConnell tells it first-hand, as the way the subject came to Congress's attention.
